bio.text: Rod Furniss represents Idaho House District 31, Seat B, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Rigby as the legislator's city.

The directory biography says Furniss graduated from Rigby High School, earned an associate degree from BYU-Idaho and a bachelor's degree in business administration and finance from Idaho State University.
It describes Furniss as a commercial and residential real estate developer and a past president of the Idaho Association of Insurance and Financial Advisors.
